dedupe_keys.name: global reference database of crowdsourced cropland data collected with geo wiki

description: This global reference dataset of cropland presence was collected in a three week Geo-Wiki crowdsourcing campaign, giving about 36,000 samples at latitude and longitude intersections, densified where cropland probability is between 25 and 75 percent. The DataCite record says it also includes a control set of 1,793 locations validated by trained students and 60 expert gold standard validations to assess volunteer quality, each in a cropland-only and a per-user form. It was published in 2017 in PANGAEA by Linda See and the Geo-Wiki campaign team under the CC BY 3.0 licence, free to download as tab-separated text. Coverage is global. Caveats: labels are volunteer image interpretations of varying quality, and the imagery dates are not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives independent samples to validate cropland maps used for agricultural exposure. Related catalogue records include the WorldCereal street imagery validation set and the Unified Cropland Layer 2014.
